title: CI-full-run visibility: test_rust_workspace.mjs wrapper suite (impacted local runs will NOT select it until D6 lands)
action: Close validation gap W4 (Rust suites invisible to CI between Slice 0 and Slice 7): add scripts/tests/test_rust_workspace.mjs, a wrapper suite auto-discovered by run_verify's test_*.mjs glob, which spawns `cargo build --release --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml` then `cargo test --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml` and fails red on any non-zero exit. If cargo is not on PATH the suite fails red with a clear message (CI must install the toolchain — never a silent skip). SCOPE HONESTY (advisor note 4): this gives CI FULL-RUN visibility only — the mjs impact registry has no Rust edges, so local --impacted runs will not select this suite until the D6 graph lands in Slice 7; local impacted-green is NOT Rust-green in the interim, and the suite header comment must say so. This is a NEW test file, not a change to frozen mjs mechanics (D1: run_verify.mjs itself is untouched; discovery is automatic).
